The legal nonprofit is BAVC Media (headquartered in San Francisco); the agenda names only 'Reel Stories' in Oakland, so the contracting entity could not be confirmed. No OUSD-specific link found. profile.summary: Reel Stories is a youth media program, now run by BAVC Media, that teaches filmmaking to girls and non-binary young people through camps, workshops and mentorship. It aims to address the gender imbalance in film production. BAVC Media is a nonprofit media arts organization in the San Francisco Bay Area.
